District Scatter.name: District Scatter
District Scatter.description: The user scatters balls across several connected streets from a high position, turning entrances, vehicle paths and escape lanes into sticky obstacles for the rest of the scene. People caught by a ball must free themselves or wait for its hold to fade. The user leaves a clearly marked evacuation lane, but cannot make the balls spare an unmarked civilian; the mass plucking draws blood and ends further ball use. Strain: severe.
